description: Structured catalogue of ARM GNU executables and the MCP tools currently exposed by EmbiMind.

cross_platform_contract.mcp_interface: Identical tool names, parameters, and result semantics on Windows and Linux.
cross_platform_contract.package_strategy: Replace the platform-specific toolchain directory; keep the Python MCP implementation shared.
cross_platform_contract.note: The resolver must select the correct executable filename for the host OS. Confirm that all lookup levels are implemented before depending on them.

toolchain_executables.name: gcc
toolchain_executables.description: GNU C compiler and driver; also drives the link step.

toolchain_executables.name: g++
toolchain_executables.description: GNU C++ compiler driver.

toolchain_executables.name: cpp
toolchain_executables.description: GNU C/C++ preprocessor.

toolchain_executables.name: as
toolchain_executables.description: GNU assembler.

toolchain_executables.name: ld
toolchain_executables.description: GNU linker.

toolchain_executables.name: ld.bfd
toolchain_executables.description: GNU BFD linker backend.

toolchain_executables.name: ar
toolchain_executables.description: Create, modify and inspect static archives.

toolchain_executables.name: ranlib
toolchain_executables.description: Generate or update an archive symbol index.

toolchain_executables.name: gcc-ar
toolchain_executables.description: GCC wrapper around ar, supporting plugin/LTO integration.

toolchain_executables.name: gcc-ranlib
toolchain_executables.description: GCC wrapper around ranlib, supporting plugin/LTO integration.

toolchain_executables.name: objcopy
toolchain_executables.description: Copy and translate object files and executable formats.

toolchain_executables.name: strip
toolchain_executables.description: Discard symbols and other information from object files.

toolchain_executables.name: objdump
toolchain_executables.description: Display information about object files and disassemble code.

toolchain_executables.name: readelf
toolchain_executables.description: Display information about ELF files.

toolchain_executables.name: nm
toolchain_executables.description: List symbols from object files.

toolchain_executables.name: size
toolchain_executables.description: Report section sizes and total memory footprint.

toolchain_executables.name: addr2line
toolchain_executables.description: Translate addresses into source file and line information.

toolchain_executables.name: strings
toolchain_executables.description: Print sequences of printable characters from files.

toolchain_executables.name: c++filt
toolchain_executables.description: Demangle encoded C++ symbol names.

toolchain_executables.name: elfedit
toolchain_executables.description: Update ELF file metadata.

toolchain_executables.name: gcov
toolchain_executables.description: Generate source coverage reports from GCC coverage data.

toolchain_executables.name: gcov-dump
toolchain_executables.description: Dump information from GCC coverage data files.

toolchain_executables.name: gcov-tool
toolchain_executables.description: Process and merge GCC coverage data.

toolchain_executables.name: gprof
toolchain_executables.description: Display profiling information from gprof data.

toolchain_executables.name: lto-dump
toolchain_executables.description: Inspect GCC link-time optimization object information.

toolchain_executables.name: gdb
toolchain_executables.description: GNU debugger for ARM bare-metal targets.

toolchain_executables.name: gdb-py
toolchain_executables.description: Python-enabled GNU debugger, if included in this toolchain build.

mcp_tools.name: check_arm_toolchain
mcp_tools.description: Detect and validate the configured ARM GNU toolchain.

mcp_tools.name: list_arm_tools
mcp_tools.description: List ARM GNU toolchain executables detected in the configured bin directory.

mcp_tools.name: compile_c
mcp_tools.description: Compile one C source file into an object file.

mcp_tools.name: compile_cpp
mcp_tools.description: Compile one C++ source file into an object file.

mcp_tools.name: preprocess_source
mcp_tools.description: Run the C/C++ preprocessor on a source file.

mcp_tools.name: link_elf
mcp_tools.description: Link object files into an ELF firmware image.

mcp_tools.name: create_static_library
mcp_tools.description: Create a static library archive from object files.

mcp_tools.name: elf_to_bin
mcp_tools.description: Convert an ELF firmware image into a raw binary.

mcp_tools.name: elf_to_hex
mcp_tools.description: Convert an ELF firmware image into Intel HEX format.

mcp_tools.name: convert_elf
mcp_tools.description: Convert an ELF image to a supported objcopy output format.

mcp_tools.name: inspect_elf_sections
mcp_tools.description: List sections in an ELF firmware image.

mcp_tools.name: inspect_elf_segments
mcp_tools.description: Inspect ELF program segments and load information.

mcp_tools.name: inspect_elf_symbols
mcp_tools.description: Inspect symbols in an ELF firmware image.

mcp_tools.name: inspect_disassembly
mcp_tools.description: Disassemble an ELF image, optionally interleaving source code.

mcp_tools.name: inspect_memory_usage
mcp_tools.description: Report ELF section memory usage using the ARM size utility.

mcp_tools.name: inspect_all_elf_headers
mcp_tools.description: Inspect all ELF header and metadata information.

mcp_tools.name: address_to_source
mcp_tools.description: Map firmware addresses to source files and line numbers.

mcp_tools.name: inspect_file_format
mcp_tools.description: Identify the file format and architecture of an object or firmware file.

execution_constraints.arguments: Pass arguments as individual list entries, never as one shell command string.
execution_constraints.nonzero_exit: A non-zero return code is a failure and must be reported.
execution_constraints.hardware_programming: Build and conversion tools do not flash hardware. Use the separate OpenOCD/GDB workflow.
